In [[40 ABY/Legends|40 ABY]],<ref name="Date">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[Legacy of the Force: Sacrifice]]'' to [[40 ABY/Legends|40 ABY]].</ref> [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lady of the Sith]] [[Lumiya]] carried a '''vibroblade''' in her [[Boot/Legends|boot]]. While entertaining the [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Alema Rar]] at her [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]] [[The Home|home]], Lumiya produced the [[Vibroblade/Legends|vibroblade]] and rammed it into her own [[Limb/Legends|leg]]. To Rar's astonishment, the blade had absolutely no effect on the Dark Lady, as all of her limbs were [[Cybernetics/Legends|prosthetic]].<ref name="Sacrifice" />

==Behind the scenes==
Lumiya's vibroblade appears in [[Karen Traviss]]' novel ''[[Legacy of the Force: Sacrifice]]'', published in [[2007]] and fifth instalment in the nine-part ''[[Star Wars: Legacy of the Force]]'' series.<ref name="Sacrifice" /> It is the only time the item is mentioned, and was noted as something she kept on her person. Traviss expressed fascination with her depiction of Lumiya and Alema Rar's interaction in ''Sacrifice'', and gave special attention to their differed perspectives on their various mutilations,<ref name="RRI">[[Star Wars: Legacy of the Force Round-Robin Interview|''Star Wars: Legacy of the Force'' Round-Robin Interview]]</ref> using the vibroblade to illustrate the extent of Lumiya's physical alterations.<ref name="Sacrifice" />
